refresh.failure_behaviour: The preview writes generated files to temporary runner storage and uploads a seven-day GitHub Actions diagnostic artifact. It does not update the README assets or a persistent asset store. A failed refresh leaves the committed snapshot unchanged; any separately published older asset remains unchanged, and its data-through date continues to age. Local reruns in the same output directory preserve the last valid bundle and pointer.
refresh.last_successful_refresh: For an Actions run, use that run's timestamp. Execution time is kept outside the deterministic bundle.
refresh.recovery: Inspect the failed run, correct the source or validator, then dispatch a new preview. Publish only after a complete successful review and separate owner approval.
refresh.workflow_mode: PR #4 diagnostic preview and default-branch workflow_dispatch; no schedule, persistent publication or deployment.
